privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.controllerBody: The controller is a natural person established in Belgium, operating Système de récompenses (kidsrewardsystem.com). Public contact: contact@kidsrewardsystem.com. Full name, postal address and entreprise number (once obtained) appear after the first paid invoice, when they are configured — never in the source code.
privacy.basesBody: Contract: the parent’s subscription and account. Parental responsibility / best interests of the child and parental consent for children’s data. The child does not conclude the contract.
privacy.rolesBody: The account belongs only to the parent. Children have profiles only (first name, tasks, screen time) managed by the parent.
privacy.minimiseBody: The child’s first name is enough. We do not collect a child photo, school, the child’s home address, or health notes.
privacy.dataLead: We only keep what is needed to run the family app and billing:
privacy.dataPinHash: a hash of the admin PIN (not the PIN itself);
privacy.dataStripe: Stripe identifiers (customer, subscription, checkout) for payment.
privacy.purposeBody: This data is used only to run the family app and billing. We do not sell your data. No behavioural ads on children’s profiles. No sharing of children’s data with marketing third parties.
privacy.processorsBody: Google Firebase (hosting, Auth, Firestore, Cloud Functions — EU region where applicable); Stripe (payments); Proton (transactional email). Each processes data under a data-processing agreement (DPA). Transfers outside the EEA, where they occur, rely on standard contractual clauses (SCCs). No analytics. No SendGrid.
privacy.storageBody: All data listed above is stored only through these processors. We do not keep personal data on a server or cloud of our own. Your data is therefore held only in Firebase, Stripe and Proton. They are established infrastructure, payment and email providers, who process the data under a DPA (and SCCs in the event of a transfer outside the EEA). The app is displayed in your browser during the session; it does not constitute separate storage on our part.
privacy.retentionBody: While the account is active. After account deletion, the family, children’s profiles and tasks are erased within 30 days, except legal or accounting duties (invoices Stripe retains). ComplimentaryForever families follow the same deletion rules.
privacy.rightsBody: Access, rectification, erasure, portability, objection. In the app (parent area): Export my data downloads a JSON of your family; Delete account cancels the Stripe subscription if any and erases Auth + Firestore (children included). Email remains a backup path. You may complain to the APD/GBA (Belgium).
privacy.securityBody: Firestore rules isolate families: a parent only reads their own. Firebase Auth. No detailed children logs in an analytics tool (there is no analytics).
privacy.kidsBody: No behavioural ads. No marketing sharing. If the app is used outside Belgium, the model remains parental consent / responsibility.
privacy.cookiesBody: We do not set analytics cookies. There is no Firebase Analytics / gtag in this app.
privacy.registerLead: A simple view (who, what, why, where, how long):
privacy.registerParentWhat: Email, locale, PIN hash, legal acceptances
privacy.registerKidsWhy: Parental responsibility / best interests of the child
privacy.registerBillingHowLong: Active account; invoices per Stripe / accounting duties
privacy.registerEmailHowLong: The time needed to send the message; no analytics tool
privacy.deletionHtml: Delete the account in the app (parent area: Delete account). That cancels the Stripe subscription if any and erases the family, children’s profiles and tasks within 30 days. You can also write to .
privacy.lawBody: Belgian law applies. The controller is established in Belgium.
terms.title: Terms of use
terms.productBody: Système de récompenses (kidsrewardsystem.com) is a Belgian dad’s product: a family app for the tasks to do and the reward in screen time.
terms.priceBody: After a 30-day trial, the subscription auto-renews at €2.50 per month or €25 per year unless you cancel.
terms.cancelBody: You can cancel or withdraw only with the “Cancel subscription / withdraw” button in the app (parent area). If you cancel during the trial: no first charge; access continues until the end of the 30-day trial, then stops. If you cancel after a paid period started: no next renewal charge; access continues until the end of the already-paid period, then stops.
terms.withdrawBody: The legal 14-day consumer withdrawal right (distance contract) is included in the 30-day trial. The paid price (€2.50/month or €25/year) is stated at signup, so there is no extra cooling-off at trial-to-paid conversion and no extra 14 days at each renewal. To withdraw or cancel, use the “Cancel subscription / withdraw” button in the app. During the trial, that avoids the first charge; access continues until the trial ends, then stops.
legal.paidNote: For questions before or during the trial: contact@kidsrewardsystem.com. Complaints may also go to kidsrewardsystem@proton.me. The full legal name, postal address and entreprise number (once obtained) are displayed in the app after the first paid invoice (not during the 30-day trial).
